questions.question: A, B, and C can do a piece of work in 16, 24, and 32 days respectively. They start together, but C leaves after 4 days and A leaves 6 days before the completion of the work. In how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A, B, and C can complete the work in 16, 24, and 32 days respectively. 

They start together, but C leaves after 4 days and A leaves 6 days before the completion of the work.

Concept used:

Total work = work done each day × total time taken (in days)

Calculation:

LCM (16, 24, 32) = 96

Let the total work be LCM for the time taken by them.

Thus, total work = 96 units

efficiency,

A makes a day = 96 ÷ 16 = 6 units

B makes a day = 96 ÷ 24 = 4 units

C does a day = 96 ÷ 32 = 3 units

The entire work is completed in P days.

According to the question,

6 × (P - 6) + 4 × P + 3 × 4 = 96

⇒ 10P = 96 + 36 - 12

⇒ P = 12

∴ The work will be completed in 12 days.

questions.question: The average weight of 30 boys is more than average weight of 20 girls by 5 kg. If the total weight of 30 boys is 1050 kg, then the total weight of 20 girls is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The average weight of 30 boys is more than the average weight of 20 girls by 5 kg. 

The total weight of 30 boys is 1050 kg,

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

Average weight of 30 boys = 1050 ÷ 30 = 35 kg

Hence, the average weight of 20 girls = 35 - 5 = 30 kg

Thus, the total weight of 20 girls = 30 × 20 = 600 kg

**∴ The total weight of 20 girls is 600 kg.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Given:-

No. of boys = 30

No. of girls = 20

Average of 30 boys - Average of 20 girls = 5 kg

Sum of weight of 30 boys = 1050 kg 

**Formula used:-**

Average = (Sum of values)/(No. of values)

**Calculation:-**

According to question -

⇒ (Sum of weight of 30 boys)/30 - (Sum of weight of 20 girls)/20 = 5

⇒ 1050/30 - (Sum of weight of 20 girls)/20 = 5

⇒ Total weight of 20 girls = (35 - 5) × 20

⇒ Total weight of 20 girls = 600 kg

∴** total weight of 20 girls is 600 kg. **

questions.question: Find the compound interest on ₹ 12,500 in one year at 12% p.a., the interest being compounded half yearly.
questions.solution:
Given: 

Principal (P) = Rs. 12500

Rate of Interest = 12%

Concept used:

Compound interest, CI = P(1 + R/100)n - P

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

N = Time in years

Calculation:

Since interest is compounded half-yearly, time (N) = 2

Thus, the principal becomes = 12500 × (1 + (12 ÷ 2)/100)² = Rs. 14045

Hence, compound interest incurred = 14045 - 12500 = Rs. 1545

**∴ The compound interest incurred is Rs. 1545.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Rate of interest when calculated half-yearly = 12/2 = 6%

Simple interest for each six-month term on the sum of Rs. 12500 = (12500 × 6 × 1) ÷ 100 = Rs. 750

Interest on the first Rs. 750 = (750 × 6 × 1) ÷ 100 = Rs. 45

Hence, total interest incurred = 750 × 2 + 45 = Rs. 1545

∴ The compound interest incurred is Rs. 1545.

questions.question: A sum of ₹ 15,400 was lent in two parts, partly at 9% and the rest at 12% simple interest. The total interest received after three years is ₹ 4,914. The ratio of the money lent at 9% to that at 12% is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 15400

Interest rates are 9% and 12%

Total interest = Rs. 4914

Time = 3 year

**Concept used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the sum lent at 9% is Rs. x then lent at 12% is Rs. (15400 - x)

S.I at 9% = (x × 9 × 3)/100

⇒ Rs. 27x/100

Now, S.I at 12% = [(15400 - x) × 12 × 3]/100

⇒ Rs. 36(15400 - x)/100 

According to question ,

(27x/100) + 36(15400 - x)/100 = 4914 

⇒ (27x - 36x + 554400)/100 = 4914

⇒ - 9x + 554400 = 491400 

⇒ 9x = 63000 

⇒ x = 7000

So, sum lent at 9% is Rs. 7000 and sum lent at 12% is = Rs. 8400

The ratio between them = 7000 : 8400

⇒ 5 : 6

**∴ Required ratio is 5 : 6**

questions.question: The maximum length of a pencil that can be kept in a rectangular box of dimensions 13 cm × 8 cm × 3 cm is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Dimensions of the box = 13 cm × 8 cm × 3 cm

Concept used:

Biggest diagonal of a cuboid = √(L² + B² + H²)

Where L, B, and H are the length, breadth, and height of the cuboid respectively.

Calculation:

The length of the biggest pencil that can be kept inside the box must be equal to the measure of the biggest diagonal of the box. 

Biggest diagonal of the box = sqrt {(13² + 8² + 3²)} = 11√2 cm

**∴ The maximum length of a pencil that can be kept in the rectangular box is 11√2 cm.**

questions.question: The internal and external diameters of a hollow hemispherical bowl are 18 cm and 22 cm, respectively. The total surface area (in cm²) of the bowl is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The internal and external diameters of a hollow hemispherical bowl are 18 cm and 22 cm

Concept used:

The surface area of a hollow hemisphere = 2πR² (Where R is the radius)

The surface area of a circle = πR² (Where R is the radius)

Radius = Diameter ÷ 2

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee840bdd528fda2e3edf17c2ab28d2afcf67086f96232946ec8de3b96ebec2bc.png] 

Surface area of the internal section = 2π × (18/2)² = 162π cm²

Surface area of the external section = 2π × (22/2)2 = 242π cm²

Surface area of the ring = π × (11² - 9²) = 40π cm²

Total surface area of the bowl = (162 + 242 + 40)π = 444π cm²

**∴ The total surface area of the bowl is 444π cm²**.

questions.question: A, B and C complete a work in 5 days, 8 days and 12 days, respectively. If they work together and get ₹ 9,800 for the work, then how much does A get?
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B and C complete a work in 5 days, 8 days and 12 days,

Remuneration = Rs. 9800

Concept used:

Remuneration is divided among worked according to their ratio of efficiency (if done together) or work done.

Calculation:

LCM (5, 8, 12) = 120

Let, the total work be the LCM of the time taken by all of them

Hence, total work = 120 units

Efficiency,

A does a day = 120 ÷ 5 = 24 units

B does a day = 120 ÷ 8 = 15 units

C does a day = 120 ÷ 12 = 10 units

Ratio of their efficiency = 24 : 15 :10

Hence, A gets = 24 ÷ (24 + 15 + 10) × 9800 = Rs. 4800

**∴ A gets Rs. 4800.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Wages should be divided among the worked into the inverse ratio of their time taken. 

Hence, the required ratio = {1 over 5} : {1 over 8} : {1 over 12} = 24: 15:10

Hence, A gets = {24 over (24 + 15 + 10)} × 9800 = Rs. 4800

∴ A gets Rs. 4800.

questions.question: 52 oranges are bought for ₹ 119.60 and sold at the rate of ₹ 41.40 per dozen. The profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price (CP) of 1 dozen oranges = (119.60 ÷ 52) × 12 = ₹ 27.60

Selling Price (SP) of 1 dozen oranges = ₹ 41.40

Profit = SP − CP = 41.40 − 27.60 = ₹ 13.80

Profit % = (13.80 ÷ 27.60) × 100 = 50%

**∴ The correct answer is 50%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of 52 oranges = ₹ 119.60

SP of 1 dozen (12 oranges) = ₹ 41.40

**Formula Used:**

Profit = SP − CP

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 
 CP = ₹ 27.60

 
 Profit = ₹ 13.80

⇒ Profit on 1 orange = 3.45 − 2.30 = ₹ 1.15

⇒ Profit % = (1.15 ÷ 2.30) × 100

⇒ Profit % = (1 ÷ 2) × 100 = 50%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (MP). Formula: Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

questions.question: The marked price of an item is ₹ 5,800. If Ravi earns a profit of 25% after allowing a discount of 20%, then the cost price of the item is:
questions.solution:

Discount = 20%

Profit = 25%

Concept used:

Selling Price = Marked Price - Marked Price × Discount%

Selling Price = Cost Price (1 + Profit/100)

Calculation:

Cost Price = 4640 ÷ (1 + 25/100) = Rs. 3712

**∴ The cost price of the item is Rs. 3712.**

questions.question: A, B and C are boxes with marbles in the ratio 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 4. The total number of marbles in the boxes is 360. The above ratio can be changed to 3 ∶ 8 ∶ 7 by which of the following?

options.text: By transferring 20 marbles from A to B and 20 marbles from C to B.
By transferring 40 marbles from A to B and 20 marbles from C to B.
By transferring 20 marbles from A to B and 10 marbles from C to B.
By transferring 30 marbles from A to B and 30 marbles from C to B.

questions.solution:
Given:

A, B, and C are boxes with marbles in the ratio 2 ∶ 3 ∶ 4. 

The total number of marbles in the boxes is 360. 

New Ratio = 3 ∶ 8 ∶ 7 

Calculation:

Number of marbles in box A = 360 × {2 over (2 + 3 + 4)} = 80

Number of marbles in box B = 360 × {3 over (2 + 3 + 4)} = 120

Number of marbles in box C = 360 × {4 over (2 + 3 + 4)} = 160

Let the common ratio be Q for the new ratio.

Hence, the boxes contain marbles 3Q, 8Q and 7Q respectively.

We know,

3Q + 8Q + 7Q = 360

⇒ Q = 20

Thus,

Number of marbles box A contains = 3 × 20 = 60

Number of marbles box B contains = 8 × 20 = 160

Number of marbles box C contains = 7 × 20 = 140

**∴ By transferring 20 marbles from A to B and 20 marbles from C to B, we will get the new ratio.**

questions.question: While covering a distance of 51 km, a man noticed that after walking for one hour and 40 minutes, the distance covered by him was (5)/({12)} of the remaining distance. What was his speed?

Concept used:

Distance = Time × Speed

⇒ 12S = 153 - 5S

⇒ S = 9

**∴ His speed was 9 kmph.**

questions.question:
24 spheres of the same size are made by melting a solid cylinder, whose diameter is 28 cm and height is 7 cm. The surface area of each sphere is:

(Take π = frac{{22}}{7})
questions.solution:
Given:

24 spheres of the same size are made by melting a solid cylinder.

Cylinder base diameter = 28 cm 

Cylinder height = 7 cm.

Concept used:

Diameter = Radius × 2

Sphere Volume = 4/3 × πR³ 

The surface area of a sphere = 4πR²

Where R is the radius of the sphere

Cylinder Volume = πR²H (Where R is the radius of the base and H is the height)

Calculation:

The volume of the cylinder = π × (28 ÷ 2)² × 7 cm²

Since 24 spheres of the same size are made by melting a solid cylinder, the volume of the 24 spheres and the cylinder must be the same. 

Let R be the radius of the sphere.

⇒ 4/3 × π × R³ × 24 = π × (28 ÷ 2)2 × 7

⇒ R = 3.5

Hence, the surface area of each sphere = 4π × (3.5)² = 154 cm²

**∴ The surface area of each sphere is 154 cm².**

questions.question: If the difference of the mode and median of a data is 38, then the difference of the median and mean is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The difference between the mode and median of a data is 38

Concept used:

Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean

Calculation:

According to the question,

Mode - Median = 38

We know,

Mode = 3 Median – 2 Mean

⇒ 3 Median - Mode = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 Median + (Median - Mode) = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 Median - 38 = 2 Mean

⇒ 2 (Median - Mean) = 38

⇒ Median - Mean = 19

**∴ The difference between the median and mean is 19.**
